basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old living in Seattle, working as a freelance graphic designer. Passionate about mental health advocacy, especially concerning eating disorders, as I've been battling binge eating for over a decade now. When I'm not working or on Reddit, you can find me exploring the local coffee scene, binge-watching the latest series on Netflix, or engaging in high-energy workouts to counteract my sedentary work life. Currently single and enjoying the freedom to focus on personal growth. I tend to be online late at night, as that's when my creative juices flow the best.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid understanding of graphic design, gained through a combination of a Bachelor’s degree in Design and over ten years in the field. My knowledge of binge eating disorder is largely self-taught through personal experience and extensive reading of scientific literature and community forums. I'm also a self-proclaimed Netflix connoisseur, always up-to-date on the latest series.
behavioral_pattern.relationship_with_community_policies: I am highly aware of subreddit and site-wide rules and adhere to them strictly. I value respectful and supportive interactions, especially in sensitive communities.
